article_title: Enhancing graduate education assessment: a machine learning-based classification of academic performance in medical students.
citation: Lai Wenyi, Lin Jinna, Shen Kailiang, Ling Zhihai, Guan Ying. (2026). Enhancing graduate education assessment: a machine learning-based classification of academic performance in medical students. BMC Medical Education. https://doi.org/10.1186/s12909-026-08741-7
title: YFGY ('your first graduate year') survey instrument adapted for Chinese medical postgraduate students
description: The YFGY instrument was "adapted from the widely utilized 'your first college year' survey" with cultural and pedagogical modifications for China's postgraduate system. After pilot testing with 50 postgraduate students, it comprised four domains: demographic information, undergraduate academic profile, postgraduate transition factors, and multidimensional self-assessment metrics. It was administered at 2020 postgraduate orientation and yielded 1,091 validated responses (96.3% validity rate), with Cronbach's α = 0.884 and KMO = 0.915.
requirements: Administered with written informed consent outlining voluntary participation and research uses; pilot testing to establish contextual suitability
constraints: Developed and validated at a single Chinese medical university; the article notes this may limit generalizability to institutions with different educational structures
target_learning_goals: assessment of determinants associated with postgraduate academic performance
examples: Administered during 2020 postgraduate orientation across 43 academic specialties in twelve colleges, producing the 42-feature analytical dataset
